Nominatim is part of 4 of my public repositories, from 2017 to 2026.

What it was for: [Systems and infrastructure](@/projects/systems.md) (2), [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md) (1) and [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (1).

Most recently: [Crisis map](@/work/crisis-map.md): Reports geocoded through a local Nominatim, stored as PostGIS geography and served from one capability registry: LiveView, REST, OpenAPI, MCP and CLI; [docks](@/work/docks.md): Repository containing useful Dockerfile(s); [simple\_geocoder](@/work/simple-geocoder.md).

1 of these projects runs as a live site.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Nominatim: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links Nominatim to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
